core_meaning.primary_meaning: Habash is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Abyssinia”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Habash corresponds to the Arabic form حبش (Arabic حبش (Ḥabash); nisba حبشي (Ḥabashī)). Its core sense is abyssinian (from habasha, i.e. ethiopia). Habash is Arabic حبش (Ḥabash) 'Abyssinia' (Habasha, i.e. Ethiopia), used as a name and the base of the nisba حبشي 'Abyssinian'. The source gloss 'from Habasha (Abyssinian)' is correct. It is an ethnonym/nisba rather than a lexical given name.

persian.name: حبش
